=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8449-8543 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The external-finalize recovery block runs after `sync_default_into_integration_branch`, so a deleted integration branch makes the sync path mark the project failed and `continue` before recovery can run.
  WHY: All reviewers who flagged it described the same root cause; when the final PR was externally merged with branch deletion, the project becomes permanently stuck in `failed` instead of transitioning to `complete`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8490-8506 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: If `_fetch_pr_json` or field extraction fails, the external-finalize block only warns and leaves `final_merge_status` pending, so the poller retries forever without a terminal error state.
  WHY: The reviewers all identified the same failure mode: transient API errors, empty results, or malformed responses cause an indefinite retry loop and keep the project in limbo.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8502-8509 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The state-file temp-write update can race because there is no lock around the read/modify/write sequence.
  WHY: Both reviewers described concurrent poll runs interleaving on the same `STATE_FILE`, which can clobber updates or leave inconsistent state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8122-8250 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The regression test hard-pins the external-finalize block to its current placement, so a correct relocation breaks the test.
  WHY: The reviewers all pointed out that moving the block before the sync step to fix the production bug would require updating this placement-sensitive test.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8496-8502 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `final_merge_pr` numeric check is structured after the value is used in the jq read path, which creates an avoidable malformed-input hazard.
  WHY: The reviewer marked this low severity because a guard exists, but still noted the sequencing could misbehave if the value is malformed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8467-8501 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The external-finalize block performs a PR lookup on every poll tick for pinned pending projects.
  WHY: The reviewers agreed this is extra REST traffic and rate-limit pressure on long-lived projects, even though it is not the main correctness bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
